# BestDealSoft

> Independent, practical reviews of software deals on AppSumo. Original reviews only; no copied vendor blurbs, no invented hands-on claims.

BestDealSoft is an independent publication and is not affiliated with AppSumo LLC. AppSumo is a third-party marketplace; offers, prices, and terms can change at any time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bestdealsoft.com/): what the site is, current status, and review principles.
- [Reviews](https://bestdealsoft.com/reviews/): the review library. Currently empty by design until original reviews are finished.
- [Editorial policy](https://bestdealsoft.com/editorial-policy/): how deals are evaluated, what every review includes, corrections, and FAQ.
- [About](https://bestdealsoft.com/about/): who runs the site and how it is funded.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://bestdealsoft.com/affiliate-disclosure/): how affiliate links work on this site.
- [Privacy notice](https://bestdealsoft.com/privacy/): what data is collected (very little).
- [Contact](https://bestdealsoft.com/contact/): hello@bestdealsoft.com — corrections, review requests, questions.
